info.title: Poof API
info.description: The developer-first standard for background removal. Precise, fast, and scalable.

post.description: Remove the background from an image. This is a synchronous endpoint that returns the processed image directly in the response body. Each successful request costs 1 credit regardless of parameters. Failed requests are not billed.

image_file.description: The image file to process (JPEG, PNG or WebP). Max 20MB. Required unless image_file_b64 or image_url is given.

image_file_b64.description: The image as a base64 string, with or without a data:<mime>;base64, prefix. Max 20MB decoded. Alternative to image_file.

image_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to process; Poof downloads it server-side (max 20MB, up to 3 redirects, 15s timeout). URLs pointing at private, loopback or link-local addresses are rejected. Alternative to image_file.

format.description: Resulting image format. For remove.bg compatibility, auto is accepted and treated as png; zip is not supported.

channels.description: Output color channels. Use 'rgba' for transparency, 'rgb' for an opaque image (background filled with bg_color, white by default), or 'alpha' for the grayscale alpha mask only.

bg_color.description: Background color (hex, rgb, or color name). Applies when channels is 'rgb' or 'rgba'.

size.description: Output image size preset (megapixel cap). Ignored when width or height is set. For remove.bg compatibility the aliases auto, 4k and 50MP (treated as full) and small and regular (treated as preview) are also accepted.

crop.description: Crop the image to the subject bounds. Pass true/false or an aspect ratio like '1:1', '4:3', '16:9'.

padding.description: Padding around the subject when crop is enabled, added to each side as a fraction (e.g. '0.1') or percentage (e.g. '10%') of the subject's size on that axis. Pass one value for both axes, or two comma-separated values as horizontal,vertical (e.g. '10%,7.5%' gives a canvas 120% of subject width and 115% of subject height). Default '10%'.

crop_margin.description: remove.bg-compatible alias for padding, using CSS margin shorthand with one to four space-separated values (e.g. '10%' or '0px 5%'). Percentages map onto padding; a zero pixel margin means a tight crop; other pixel margins cannot be honoured and are ignored. Ignored when padding is set.

width.description: Output width in pixels (1-6000). On its own, the height follows the image's aspect ratio. Together with height, the image is fitted into a width x height canvas according to fit. The aspect ratio is always preserved (never stretched); smaller images are upscaled unless fit is 'scale-down'. Overrides size.

height.description: Output height in pixels (1-6000). On its own, the width follows the image's aspect ratio. Together with width, the image is fitted into a width x height canvas according to fit. The aspect ratio is always preserved (never stretched); smaller images are upscaled unless fit is 'scale-down'. Overrides size.

fit.description: How to fit the image into width/height. 'contain' scales the image to fit inside and centres it, filling the remaining area with transparency (or bg_color). 'cover' scales the image to fill the canvas and crops the overflow, keeping the subject centred. 'scale-down' is like 'contain' but never enlarges: a smaller image keeps its native size (centred on the canvas when both dimensions are set). contain and cover only differ when both width and height are set.

schema.description: Provide exactly one image input: image_file (upload), image_file_b64 (base64) or image_url (public URL). If several are sent, image_file wins, then image_file_b64, then image_url.

Content-Type.description: MIME type of the returned image

X-Request-ID.description: Unique request identifier for support

X-Matte-Confidence.description: Heuristic confidence in the alpha matte, 0-1. Mean decisiveness of the mask: 1 means fully binary, lower values mean the model hedged. Not a calibrated probability.

X-Matte-Ambiguous-Ratio.description: Fraction of pixels with alpha between 0.1 and 0.9, 0-1. High values indicate large uncertain regions; useful for flagging results for review.

X-Request-ID.description: Unique request identifier, equal to request_id in the body. Include it when contacting support.

post.description: Remove the background from a video. This is an asynchronous endpoint: the video is probed and validated synchronously, then accepted with 202 and processed in the background. Poll GET /video/jobs/{id} (or pass webhook_url) and download the output from GET /video/jobs/{id}/result once the job is completed. Costs 5 credits per second of source video, rounded up (10 credits per second above 30 fps), charged on acceptance and refunded automatically if the job fails. Limits: 5 minutes, 100 MB upload or 500 MB via URL; output is capped at 1080p (longest side 1920 px) and audio is preserved.

video_file.description: The video file to process (MP4, MOV, WebM, M4V or MKV). Max 100MB. Required unless video_url is given.

video_url.description: Public https URL of the video to process; Poof downloads it server-side (max 500MB). Alternative to video_file.

format.description: Output format. 'webm': transparent WebM (VP9 yuva420p, Opus audio). 'mov': transparent QuickTime (ProRes 4444 yuva444p10le, AAC audio). 'mp4': H.264 with the subject composited on bg_color (AAC audio, no alpha). 'mask': grayscale alpha mask as H.264 MP4 (no audio). 'png': ZIP of RGBA PNG frames (no audio).

bg_color.description: Solid background colour (hex, rgb() or colour name) for format 'mp4'. Ignored for other formats. Defaults to chroma green.

webhook_url.description: https URL that receives a POST with the job object plus an event field (video.completed or video.failed) when the job finishes. Headers X-Poof-Event, X-Poof-Job-Id and X-Poof-Attempt are set. Up to 3 attempts, 10 seconds apart, 10 second timeout; any 2xx counts as delivered.

stabilize.description: Temporal stabilisation of the matte: static edges lean on previous frames so they do not flicker while moving pixels trust the fresh prediction. Scene cuts reset the history. Set false for an independent per-frame matte.

schema.description: Provide exactly one video input: video_file (upload, max 100MB) or video_url (public https URL, max 500MB).

get.description: Streams the output file of a completed video job. Content-Type depends on the requested format (video/webm, video/quicktime, video/mp4 or application/zip) and Content-Disposition is attachment; filename=result.<ext>. Free. Returns 409 job_not_ready while the job is queued or processing (or if it failed) and 404 job_not_found once the result has expired, 24 hours after completion.
